name: Microsoft SQL Server
description: SQL Server 2016 and later, Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance (detected from the version banner). Database and schema levels; one connection per database. Reads the sys catalog views. Not yet run against a real server.

properties.label: Databases to read
properties.help: Empty: only the database above. *: every database you can access. Or a list; wildcards allowed.

version.sql: select cast(serverproperty('ProductVersion') as nvarchar(128)) as version, @@version as banner

test.sql: select suser_sname() as login, db_name() as current_database, cast(serverproperty('ProductVersion') as nvarchar(128)) as version

source.sql: select 'Microsoft SQL Server' as product, cast(serverproperty('ProductVersion') as nvarchar(128)) as version, @@version as banner, suser_sname() as login

databases.sql: select d.name as name, suser_sname(d.owner_sid) as owner, d.create_date as created_at from sys.databases d where d.state = 0 and has_dbaccess(d.name) = 1 order by d.name

schemas.sql: select s.name as name, user_name(s.principal_id) as owner from sys.schemas s order by s.name

sql: select top ({{limit|int}}) o.name as name, case o.type when 'U' then 'table' when 'V' then 'view' end as type,
cast(ep.value as nvarchar(4000)) as comment,
(select sum(p.rows) from sys.partitions p where p.object_id = o.object_id and p.index_id in (0, 1)) as row_count,
m.definition as definition, o.create_date as created_at, o.modify_date as updated_at
from sys.objects o
join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = o.schema_id
left join sys.extended_properties ep on ep.major_id = o.object_id and ep.minor_id = 0 and ep.class = 1
and ep.name = 'MS_Description'
left join sys.sql_modules m on m.object_id = o.object_id
where s.name = {{schema}} and o.type in ('U', 'V') and o.is_ms_shipped = 0 [[and o.name > {{after}}]]
order by o.name
select t.name as dataset, c.column_id as ordinal, c.name as name,
type_name(c.user_type_id) + case
when type_name(c.user_type_id) in ('varchar', 'char', 'varbinary', 'binary')
then '(' + case when c.max_length = -1 then 'max' else cast(c.max_length as varchar(10)) end + ')'
when type_name(c.user_type_id) in ('nvarchar', 'nchar')
then '(' + case when c.max_length = -1 then 'max' else cast(c.max_length / 2 as varchar(10)) end + ')'
when type_name(c.user_type_id) in ('decimal', 'numeric')
then '(' + cast(c.precision as varchar(10)) + ',' + cast(c.scale as varchar(10)) + ')'
else '' end as data_type,
c.is_nullable as nullable, object_definition(c.default_object_id) as default_value,
cast(ep.value as nvarchar(4000)) as comment,
case when c.is_identity = 1 or c.is_computed = 1 then 1 else 0 end as is_generated
from sys.columns c
join sys.objects t on t.object_id = c.object_id
join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = t.schema_id
left join sys.extended_properties ep on ep.major_id = c.object_id and ep.minor_id = c.column_id and ep.class = 1
and ep.name = 'MS_Description'
where s.name = {{schema}} and t.name in ({{datasets}})
order by t.name, c.column_id
select t.name as dataset, k.name as name, case k.type when 'PK' then 'primary_key' else 'unique' end as type,
c.name as columns, ic.key_ordinal as seq
from sys.key_constraints k
join sys.objects t on t.object_id = k.parent_object_id
join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = t.schema_id
join sys.index_columns ic on ic.object_id = k.parent_object_id and ic.index_id = k.unique_index_id
join sys.columns c on c.object_id = ic.object_id and c.column_id = ic.column_id
where s.name = {{schema}} and t.name in ({{datasets}})
order by t.name, k.name, ic.key_ordinal
select t.name as dataset, fk.name as name, 'foreign_key' as type, pc.name as columns,
db_name() as ref_database, schema_name(rt.schema_id) as ref_schema, rt.name as ref_dataset,
rc.name as ref_columns, fkc.constraint_column_id as seq
from sys.foreign_keys fk
join sys.objects t on t.object_id = fk.parent_object_id
join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = t.schema_id
join sys.foreign_key_columns fkc on fkc.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id
join sys.columns pc on pc.object_id = fkc.parent_object_id and pc.column_id = fkc.parent_column_id
join sys.objects rt on rt.object_id = fk.referenced_object_id
join sys.columns rc on rc.object_id = fkc.referenced_object_id and rc.column_id = fkc.referenced_column_id
where s.name = {{schema}} and t.name in ({{datasets}})
order by t.name, fk.name, fkc.constraint_column_id
select t.name as dataset, cc.name as name, 'check' as type, cc.definition as definition
from sys.check_constraints cc
join sys.objects t on t.object_id = cc.parent_object_id
join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = t.schema_id
where s.name = {{schema}} and t.name in ({{datasets}})
order by t.name, cc.name
select t.name as dataset, i.name as name, i.is_unique as is_unique, i.is_primary_key as is_primary,
lower(i.type_desc) as method, c.name as columns, ic.key_ordinal as seq
from sys.indexes i
join sys.objects t on t.object_id = i.object_id
join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = t.schema_id
join sys.index_columns ic on ic.object_id = i.object_id and ic.index_id = i.index_id and ic.key_ordinal > 0
join sys.columns c on c.object_id = ic.object_id and c.column_id = ic.column_id
where s.name = {{schema}} and t.name in ({{datasets}}) and i.name is not null
order by t.name, i.name, ic.key_ordinal
select distinct o.name as dataset, coalesce(d.referenced_database_name, db_name()) as upstream_database,
coalesce(d.referenced_schema_name, schema_name(ro.schema_id), s.name) as upstream_schema,
d.referenced_entity_name as upstream_dataset, 'view_dependency' as kind
from sys.sql_expression_dependencies d
join sys.objects o on o.object_id = d.referencing_id
join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = o.schema_id
left join sys.objects ro on ro.object_id = d.referenced_id
where s.name = {{schema}} and o.type = 'V' and d.referenced_class = 1
select p.name as name, case p.type when 'R' then 'role' when 'G' then 'group' when 'X' then 'group'
else 'user' end as type, case when p.type in ('S', 'U', 'E') then 1 else 0 end as can_login
from sys.database_principals p
where p.is_fixed_role = 0 and p.name not in ('sys', 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA', 'guest', 'public')
order by p.name
select o.name as dataset, pr.name as principal, lower(pe.permission_name) as privilege, 'table' as object_type,
case when pe.state = 'W' then 1 else 0 end as grantable
from sys.database_permissions pe
join sys.objects o on o.object_id = pe.major_id and pe.class = 1
join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = o.schema_id
join sys.database_principals pr on pr.principal_id = pe.grantee_principal_id
where s.name = {{schema}} and pe.state in ('G', 'W')
order by 1, 2, 3
select sp.name as name, 'row_access' as type, o.name as dataset, pr.predicate_definition as definition,
sp.is_enabled as enabled
from sys.security_policies sp
join sys.security_predicates pr on pr.object_id = sp.object_id
join sys.objects o on o.object_id = pr.target_object_id
join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = o.schema_id
where s.name = {{schema}}
union all
select 'masking:' + c.name, 'masking', o.name, c.masking_function, 1
from sys.masked_columns c
join sys.objects o on o.object_id = c.object_id
join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = o.schema_id
where s.name = {{schema}}
